content.text:
I fixed the about page on phones by deleting one CSS rule at the end of `site/css/pages.css`.

The page's story section sits in a two-column grid, with the image fixed at 480px wide. Below 720px, a mobile rule is supposed to collapse it to one column. The stray rule was `.story { grid-template-columns: 1fr 480px; }`, placed after that mobile rule. It overrode the mobile rule, so the 480px image stayed in place and pushed the page wider than a phone screen.

I did not check the page at phone width in a browser. The 16 functional tests pass, but they don't test layout. The desktop layout is unchanged, because the same two-column declaration is still earlier in the file.

I didn't commit anything.

STATUS: DONE
